expected_behaviour: Reconstructs multi-hop lineage without declaring criminal guilt.

hypotheses.title: Digital Receipt Alteration (Fabricated or Edited Amount)
hypotheses.description: Disputed payment screenshot was digitally altered to display ₹15,000.00 instead of the actual ₹25,000.00 debited from the bank account.

supporting_observations.detail: Official Core Banking record reflects debit of ₹25,000.00 under RRN 202602148891.
Error Level Analysis detected localized compression hotspots around amount bounding box.

contradictory_observations.detail: Payer text message claims: 'Sent Rs 15,000.00 as agreed'.

missing_evidence: Server-side UPI Switch (NPCI) raw switch transaction message payload.
Original uncompressed mobile screenshot directly extracted from device storage (DCIM/Screenshots).
assumptions: Core banking statement from Axis Bank accurately records all cleared debits.
Disputed screenshot originated from the same transaction as RRN 202602148891.
alternative_explanations: Payer genuinely believed amount was ₹15,000 due to third-party merchant split.
recommended_discriminative_checks: Issue Section 91 CrPC / Section 94 BNSS notice to NPCI requesting switch response for RRN 202602148891.
Inspect mobile device filesystem timestamps and file size for original PNG/JPEG screenshot.

hypotheses.title: Split Transaction Sequence (Partial Settlement)
hypotheses.description: The payment of ₹25,000.00 represents one part of a multi-leg or split transfer, where the ₹15,000.00 screenshot corresponds to a distinct concurrent payment leg.

supporting_observations.detail: Chat discussion references partial advance payment.

contradictory_observations.detail: Bank statement records only a single transfer under reference 202602148891.

missing_evidence: Secondary bank statement or credit card statement from alternate account.
Merchant ledger reflecting pending balance of ₹10,000.
assumptions: Payer maintains multiple bank accounts or UPI applications.
alternative_explanations: Payer sent screenshot from an older or uncompleted test transaction.
recommended_discriminative_checks: Request 30-day comprehensive banking statement across all accounts held by payer.
Query recipient merchant payment gateway for secondary settled UTRs on transaction date.

hypotheses.title: Account Takeover or Unauthorized Debit Inflation
hypotheses.description: Payer initiated a transfer for ₹15,000.00, but malicious software or session takeover manipulated the API payload to execute a ₹25,000.00 transfer.

supporting_observations.detail: Concurrent mobile data session detected near transaction timestamp.

contradictory_observations.detail: UPI PIN authentication authenticated successfully without chargeback report.

missing_evidence: Device forensic extraction dump (Cellebrite / Oxygen) inspecting running background services.
Telecom IPDR logs checking concurrent active data sessions and destination IP addresses.
assumptions: Payer device may host unvetted third-party remote administration apps (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, QuickSupport).
alternative_explanations: Payer made a typographical entry error entering 25000 instead of 15000.
recommended_discriminative_checks: Conduct physical forensic triage of payer handset inspecting installed package list and accessibility permissions.
Request IPDR logs from Airtel/Jio for source IP correlation during UPI PIN entry.

hypotheses.title: Synthetic Spoof Payment Interface (FakePay / Simulator UI)
hypotheses.description: The submitted payment receipt was generated using an offline fake payment simulator (FakePay) and was never transmitted over the NPCI UPI switch or acquiring bank gateway.

supporting_observations.detail: Reference number 202602148891 is completely absent from Core Banking clearing records.
Interface typography and layout mismatch official NPCI specifications.

missing_evidence: Device application package extraction checking for com.fakepay or spoof APK signatures.
NPCI central switch transaction log query.
assumptions: Perpetrator utilized a client-side Android prank or spoof application.
alternative_explanations: Transaction was routed through an unlisted third-party PPI wallet rather than bank UPI.
recommended_discriminative_checks: Query NPCI for existence of global transaction reference 202602148891.
Inspect device package manager (pm list packages) for fake payment generators.

hypotheses.title: Core Banking Auto-Reversal or Clearing Settlement Refund
hypotheses.description: Debit occurred at the payer bank but timed out at the beneficiary acquiring core, resulting in an automatic credit reversal under NPCI settlement guidelines.

supporting_observations.detail: Matching credit reversal detected within 24-48 hours of transaction.

contradictory_observations.detail: Screenshot shows final status 'SUCCESS' without reversal annotation.

missing_evidence: NPCI Dispute Management System (DMS) chargeback / reversal record.
Beneficiary bank statement reflecting inward credit rejection.
assumptions: Beneficiary CBS timeout caused automatic reverse clearing.
alternative_explanations: Merchant initiated manual refund outside the UPI protocol.
recommended_discriminative_checks: Inspect statement credit entries within 48 hours for REV/RET/REFUND descriptors.
Issue Section 94 BNSS inquiry to acquiring bank regarding RRN settlement status.

hypotheses.title: Benign Telecom Latency or App Display Lag (No Fraud)
hypotheses.description: The discrepancy is attributable to transient network latency or mobile app UI delay, where the receipt captured a temporary pending/intermediate state.

supporting_observations.detail: Low signal strength or cell handoff during transaction window.

contradictory_observations.detail: Absence of digital manipulation if screenshot is authentic.

missing_evidence: UPI App client-side diagnostic log file.
assumptions: App UI displayed provisional confirmation prior to receiving gateway ACK.
recommended_discriminative_checks: Correlate exact device clock against network time protocol (NTP) server.

hypotheses.title: Unresolved / Insufficient Corroborating Evidence
hypotheses.description: Available digital artifacts are insufficient to establish a conclusive evidentiary finding. Epistemic uncertainty must be maintained pending statutory evidence acquisition.

supporting_observations.detail: Key corroborating sources (NPCI switch logs, device extraction) remain unacquired.

alternative_explanations: Independent third-party technical failure or intermediary spoofing.
recommended_discriminative_checks: Execute prioritized statutory evidence acquisition under Section 94 BNSS / Section 91 CrPC.
